about.title: About Us
about.mission: Zero is a locally organized email service that keeps provider synchronization separate from your mailbox data. We help busy professionals manage inboxes, folders, labels, threads, and drafts from one consistent local model.
about.started: We started Zero because provider-specific mailbox behavior makes it difficult to build a consistent email workflow. Zero keeps synchronization and delivery behind provider plugins while standard mailbox operations run against a local source of truth.
about.openSourceIntro: Zero is built on the principles of transparency and community collaboration. Our entire codebase is open source, allowing anyone to:
about.openSourceReview: Review our code for security and privacy
about.openSourceSelfHost: Self-host their own instance of Zero
about.openSourceLearn: Learn from and build upon our work
about.openSourceConclusion: We believe that email is too important to be controlled by a single entity. By being open source, we ensure that Zero remains transparent, trustworthy, and accessible to everyone.
about.journeyEarlyAccess: We launched our early access program and found that users want one dependable mailbox across providers, with local folders, labels, threads, drafts, and search behaving consistently.
about.journeyOpportunity: The opportunity is massive: over 4 billion people use email daily, and most still manage it manually. Zero is poised to fundamentally change the way the world deals with communication and tasks—and we're just getting started.
about.foundersBackground: Adam and Nizar, the cofounders of Zero, met through family friends. Coming from backgrounds in product design and software engineering, we both felt the pain of drowning in email firsthand while trying to build and grow companies.
about.foundersBelief: We're driven by a shared belief that email should help you move faster, not slow you down.
about.contactIntro: Want to learn more about Zero? Get in touch:
